name: dsh-zcode-coding-plan
description: DeepSeek Harness desktop plugin that calls GLM Coding Plan models through the official ZCode CLI. Rides the ZCode channel (1.5x plan credits, context caching, native agent tools) via per-spawn provider-override env. Registers zcode_call (task dispatch, supports --resume multi-turn) and zcode_quota (plan headroom query).

scripts.test: node test/register.test.mjs && node test/schema.test.mjs && node test/gate.test.mjs && node test/negative-gate.test.mjs
